sehemu: Part III: The Prime Minister, the Cabinet and the Government
jina: Oath of office of Ministers and Deputy Ministers
maudhui: A Minister or a Deputy Minister shall not assume office until he has first taken and subscribed before the President, the oath of allegiance and such other oath relating to the execution of the functions of his office as may be prescribed by an Act of Parliament.
